Seamless 360 degree cylindrical panorama strip of sky and open ocean, a skybox backdrop for a stylised video game with the stylised realism of a modern Nintendo golf game: believable light and atmosphere, bold saturated colour, slightly painterly. A perfectly straight level horizon line runs across the whole image at one fifth of the height from the bottom edge. Below the horizon only calm turquoise tropical sea fading to deep blue. Above it a perfect tropical afternoon: rich saturated blue sky deepening toward the top, towering sunlit cumulus cloud banks piled along the horizon all the way round, a few small fair-weather puffs higher up, clean open blue at the very top of the image. The sun sits in the left third, about one third of the way up the sky, a small bright disc with a soft warm glow, lighting the cloud edges gold. Three or four tiny hazy blue silhouettes of far-off jungle islands with small peaks sit on the horizon, spaced around the panorama. No foreground, no beach, no boats, no birds, no people, no text, no lens flare streaks, no vignette. The left edge and the right edge match exactly so the strip wraps around seamlessly.
